SELECT 
  ts_doy,
  ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32), 1) as wtemp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_doy >= 237 AND ts_season = 2 AND ts_hour = 0
GROUP BY ts_doy
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler,
  ROUND(AVG(anglers), 1) as avg_anglers
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 285 AND fish_date_doy <= 295 AND fish_date_season IN (0, 1)
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as num_trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(SUM(yt)::FLOAT / SUM(anglers), 2) as yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE fish_date_doy >= 235 AND fish_date_doy <= 244 AND fish_date_season = 2 GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy, cls
